source.title: Toward a Uniform Algorithm and Uniform Reduction for Constraint Problems
source.source_statement: The paper states that AIP can be enhanced by a natural form of recursion, that early results look promising, and that the ideas will be shared in a separate paper.

keymaster_policy.promotion_condition: A public primary source must appear with a formal algorithm/theorem contract that can be independently replayed.

relevance.reason: Recursive AIP is explicitly presented as a new algorithmic direction distinct from singleton and fixed higher-level approaches, so it may become a future representation-changing/global-coherence donor.
